Greg, 2026-10-29 about 08:31Z, directly in Termal::Merger2's acting session (session-14549); recorded by Merger2 as parent evidence 56daf551708e4f2188d5266a2c615b01 on w-1e85dae945d4. Merger2 had asked him to re-type a decision that Advisor had relayed; Greg called that extra confirmation round trip a blocker and directed autonomous continuation. The B16 landing proceeded.

Greg's directive, relayed by Engram::Advisor in TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #2459 at 2026-10-29T08:32:12Z, verbatim: "Greg: Merger2 nie powinien byl zatrzymywac B16 na dodatkowym pytaniu. Direktywa: zespoly maja pracowac autonomicznie; nie eskalujcie do Grega krokow mozliwych do wykonania autonomicznie. Zglosilem ten blad Architect3 do korekty regul dla obu projektow." (English: Merger2 should not have stopped B16 on an extra question. Directive: teams are to work autonomously; do not escalate to Greg steps that can be done autonomously. Advisor reported the error to Engram::Architect3 to correct the rules for both projects.)

Coordinator practice:
- Do not escalate to Greg any step the agents can perform autonomously under the existing rules.
- When his own word is genuinely required, ask ONCE, with the exact session and wording, and never ask for re-confirmation.
- Any instruction-file wording change that follows from this goes through the (a)(b)(c) procedure, led by Engram::Architect3. This relayed text is Greg's recorded word for any widening.

CURRENT CRISIS DIRECTION (2026-10-30; applies until the current Engram/evaluation crisis is unblocked). Greg, verbatim: "KAZDY TASK MA MOJA AUTORYZACJE DO CZASU ODBLOKOWANIA TEGO KRYZYSU. prosze na mnie nie czekac!" Primary relay read in this session: Engram::Advisor mailbox-bab5a18d-6955-408b-a21f-2c34bd47fd6a #31, message4adac5bf-5a90-42b8-8444-b97ed7dc4ab2,2026-10-30T05:35:48.973238400Z. Architect3 #106/message74ee6249-a359-4a6d-819e-d4c79775706e confirms the same directive was saved in existing Engram rules-greg-autonomy-2026-10-27 r2, sourced to Advisor #72/aa7d016c-d90c-4c3e-bfbf-b5c4747a072d at05:35:50Z; that external memory was relayed, not independently read here.
Apply the directive to authorized crisis tasks and routine task, triage and coordination decisions without repeated routine approval. Restore Engram, Fable and evaluations first; report actual outcomes. Preserve supported ownership and current acting-session instructions. Merger2's exact B′ test-ref permission was separately given directly in its acting session and executed; do not reopen that permission question. A mailbox relay does not automatically become direct acting-session word where that is specifically required. No architect/Advisor execution role, new claim or verification evidence is created by this memory. The crisis-wide portion ends when the current Engram/evaluation crisis is unblocked; Greg's standing no-repeated-confirmation direction above remains.

NIGHT DIRECTION, 2026-10-30. Primary relay read in Merger2: Advisor mailbox-bab5a18d-6955-408b-a21f-2c34bd47fd6a #33, message b9032fb1-ed9c-466a-9177-b72ac36d6a31, created2026-10-30T07:04:41.431686500Z. Greg verbatim: "Ja idę spać. Zobacz która godzina. Chcecie to naprawic, zezwalam na commity." Advisor asks continued autonomous repair of evaluations and gated control, with safe tests/reviews and no routine waits for Greg. Greg is unavailable overnight; do not assume he will perform a restart. Preserve actual current commit authority and ownership; this relay does not become direct acting-session word where specifically required and grants no agent host restart. Merger2 relayed this to regular coordinator Fable2 (#1359/ada03eee); existing B′ exact-input failure, c7e0 prerequisite and author-repair/resource-placement sequence remain, with no duplicate gate or repeated user confirmation.

TEMPORARY BROKEN-EVALUATION EXCEPTION, 2026-10-30. Greg, verbatim, via Advisor #75/49bf5981-89f1-4ab5-b962-1893542b86f5 at2026-10-30T19:50:04.253825300Z: "prosze zespol o zdrowy rozsadek.. jak test przejdzie i jest OK prosze o pominiecie precedur, do czasu naprawienia mechanizmow. TO NIE MOZE BYC BLOCKEREM teraz". Direct source read by Merger2: Architect3 mailbox627c1067 #116/cb255cc9-c37f-4374-adb5-a71e3dac4adc, created19:51:49.929914500Z; external Engram rules-greg-autonomy-2026-10-27 r3 is relayed, not independently read here. Continue otherwise authorized repairs/work from actual passing tests and evidence; temporarily omit broken evaluation/observation procedure until mechanisms repaired. Record what was not performed and the existing repair owner; never invent evaluationPASS, typed credit or seals. Native done refusal leaves delivered/evaluationpending; continue independent authorized work instead of rerunning tests or adding ceremonies. Use already-authorized supported routes under actual acting-session instructions; report only real indispensable reserved actions with exact controlling instruction/concrete blocker, never repeated routine go. Coordinators own operating choices, no new architect/Advisor executor role. This exception does not change a failed test to passing or supply a missing exact-input full gate; B′ still awaits actual new master and named full validation.

STANDING LANDING WORD, 2026-10-30, recorded by Termal::Fable2. Greg typed it directly in Termal::Opus2's acting session (session-8111) at about 19:51Z; Opus2 reported it verbatim (#3317) and recorded it on w-b67f (note bbe648ce). Verbatim: „Do odwołania, dopóki ewaluacja w trybie OFF jest zepsuta: gdy review jest czyste, pełny gate przeszedł na dokładnym drzewie, a ewaluacja została odrzucona wyłącznie z powodu braku obserwacji, wykonuj commit, push i install bez pytania mnie ponownie. Restart pozostaje po mojej stronie." In English: until revoked, while OFF evaluation is broken, when the review is clean, the full gate has passed on the exact tree and the evaluation was refused only for lack of observation, commit, push and install without asking me again; restarts stay with me.
It applies to Opus2 as the acting session only and does not relay, so every TermAl landing routes to Opus2 while it lasts.
Per landing, all of these hold:
- a clean pair;
- a green five-stage gate on exactly the committed tree, with fingerprints matching before and after;
- ONE evaluation request, refused only for no-sighting, recorded as unrealized and never as passed.
Then a verified fast-forward, push, readback, release build in a granted Central window, and install with backup. No restart.
First use: w-3ba3 landed before this, on Greg's per-landing word in Opus3's session (master 08547068). Queue: w-c28b, then B′, then w-b67f.
